Gestures.Web.AutoStartDescription: Open MyGestures in the tray when you sign in.
Gestures.Web.Description: Hold the right mouse button and draw, then release to run the assigned action. Closing this window keeps gestures running in the system tray.
Gestures.Web.EnableDescription: Listen for right-button gestures on this computer.
Gestures.Web.GameModeDescription: Pause gestures while another app is fullscreen, so games and videos keep the right mouse button.
Gestures.Web.LanguageDescription: Language for the settings window and gesture trail.
Gestures.Web.ThemeDescription: Choose a light or dark appearance.
Gestures.Web.Timeout: The operation timed out. Try again.
Plugin.Settings.Gestures.ConflictLose: Conflicts with "{{name}}", which will take priority.
Plugin.Settings.Gestures.ConflictWins: Conflicts with "{{name}}". This one takes priority.
Plugin.Settings.Gestures.HeaderActionTip: The name of this gesture action.
Plugin.Settings.Gestures.HeaderGestureTi: Click to re-record. Hold the right mouse button and draw.
Plugin.Settings.Gestures.HeaderProcessTi: Only trigger this gesture in the specified processes. Leave empty to apply to all processes.
Plugin.Settings.Gestures.HeaderTriggerTi: The action to run. Click to choose a keyboard shortcut or mouse button.
